So, Ender, no more work tonight. What do you like doing after the office?
I like working out. I go to the gym almost every night. It is my time to relax.
Really? I don’t like running, but I love dancing. Do you like music?
Yes, I love listening to music. I like songs with good lyrics.
Me too! So, what do you want to do in Austin this weekend?
I want to see live music. Austin is famous for that, right?
Yes! There is a concert on Saturday. Do you want to come?
Yes, I want to go. Thank you! But I don’t want to watch TV. I don’t like watching TV.
Ha! No TV, I promise. Only music.
What do you like doing after work?

On weekends, I don't like working. My phone is off! On Saturdays, I like cooking for my friends, and on Sundays I love walking in Central Park. I don't like going to the gym, but I like walking. And next year, I want to learn Portuguese. Many of our partners are in Brazil, and I want to say more than obrigada!

I sit at my computer all day, so after work I love running. I usually run by the river, in the evening. In April, I want to run the London Marathon: forty-two kilometers! When I run, I like listening to music. I love old rock songs, the songs my father likes. I don't like running without music. It is boring.
